payload.name: Preserve original event facts on related updates
payload.description: When updating an existing event memory and the incoming message describes a later development of the same project, work, or task, preserve the original achievement facts by adding a new memory or limiting the update to changed fields.
content: If a new message reports a later development of an already recorded event (e.g., showing, publishing, or presenting completed work), do not replace the original event content with the new development.
Prefer ADD a separate event memory for the later development, or UPDATE only non-core fields while retaining the original completion date, action, and outcome.
During extraction, when the same subject/work appears in a later message, extract the new information as a candidate for a new event unless the message explicitly revises the earlier fact.

solves: When a later message describes a new development of a work whose original completion was already stored, the construction agent sometimes overwrites the older event memory, erasing original achievement facts. The reusable rule is to treat later related developments as additive or separate memories, preserving completion and date. This applies whenever a new message references a previously recorded project, task, or creation.
